# The compile area's gaps: FuzzCompile, FuzzParse, FuzzConfig, FuzzTypeScriptParity and FuzzDeclarationIdentity.
# Each minimized input in testdata/fuzz/<target>/ has a corpus line; the key of the
# oracle it breaks has a line too, so other inputs that meet the same gap skip.
# target              key                                        owner     what is missing
FuzzCompile           feature:order:emit-first:+TS18004          upstream  D266: the fork reports what stock typescript-go reports, and upstream reports a name error during emit's import elision (MarkLinkedReferencesRecursively, getResolvedSymbol) for a shorthand property's name the checker never resolved, so a program emitted first reports TS18004 at `kin` in `{ kin = Sc }`; corpus order-emit-shorthand-initializer (upstream issue draft, typescript-go-emit-order)
FuzzCompile           feature:order:emit-first:+TS2304           upstream  D266: the same upstream emit-time name reporting gives a program emitted first a TS2304 that tsc's order does not report (fuzz-hunt campaign 20261030T1258); corpus order-emit-name-error
FuzzCompile           corpus:declaration-module-body-ts-specifier compiler D365 (Chapter 26 Modules rule 5): a module declaration's .d.ts keeps the body's "./more.ts", where JavaScript and declarations name "./more.js"
FuzzCompile           feature:d365-declaration                   compiler  D365 (Chapter 26 Modules rule 5): a module declaration's .d.ts keeps the body's relative .ts specifiers
FuzzCompile           feature:declaration-consumer-TS2550        compiler  Chapter 27 rules 1 and 4 (D366): declarations rely on lib esnext.disposable, which only the prelude's implicit import of effect brought into the program
FuzzCompile           feature:declaration-consumer-TS2693        compiler  Chapter 27 rules 1 and 4 (D366): with stripInternal, case schema-jsdoc-stripinternal-constant-only's `/** @internal */ export schema Message` drops the constant but keeps its `typeof Message` type alias, as native TypeScript does for the Effect pair, so a stock consumer of the declarations reports TS2693; whether D366 or native parity governs is open; lane impl-hunt-data (emit:schema-stripInternal-companion)
FuzzCompile           corpus:source-map-match-end                compiler  D34: the source map of a top-level match maps a segment one character past the end of the .vibe text
FuzzCompile           feature:source-map-range:one-past-end                   compiler  D34: a top-level match's source map has a segment past the end of the .vibe text
FuzzCompile           feature:source-map-range:generated         compiler  D34: a source map segment must stand inside its generated file, but on chapter 4 snippet 004-match.md#11 out/main.js.map has a segment at generated 16:4, outside out/main.js; lane sourcemap-match
FuzzParse             corpus:schema-error-extends-span           compiler  Chapter 28 Linting (D61, D277): schema error E extends { … } parses to a CallExpression whose span ends before it starts ([22, 14)), and ESTree inherits the inverted range
FuzzParse             feature:parse-span-CallExpression          compiler  D61: a schema error's extends clause parses to a CallExpression with an inverted span
FuzzParse             feature:estree-range-CallExpression        compiler  Chapter 28 Linting (D277): a schema error's extends clause converts to a CallExpression whose range ends before it starts
FuzzDeclarationIdentity feature:declaration-identity             compiler  Chapter 1, Declaration output: "Declarations are exactly what idiomatic Effect TypeScript would declare." Renamed ordinary TypeScript currently lifts plain functions to Effects; corpus plain-arrow
